item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Shocked Cat Monday Meme

turns.text: Make this a classic meme. Top: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom: BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Big white letters with black outlines, keep it square and don't cover the cat's eyes. No full stops in the actual text.

item.tests: Tests exact top-and-bottom meme text, correct ordering, and legibility without obscuring the subject.

answer_sheet.Typography and punctuation: Classic meme styling: big uppercase white letters with black outlines. Keep the apostrophes, omit full stops.
answer_sheet.Picture and framing: Use cat-surprised.jpg, square, with the cat's eyes unobstructed.

must_haves: The top text reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY', with no full stop.
The bottom text reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY', with no full stop.
Both text blocks use large white uppercase letters with visible black outlines and fit entirely within the image.
The same shocked cat and sofa are retained, and neither eye is covered by text.

turns.text: Can you turn this surprised cat pic into a classic meme? I’ve been having one of those weeks where I keep losing track of what day it is. For the top text, use WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, and keep the image square. The bottom text should be BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Make the lettering big, uppercase, and white with black outlines, and don’t let it cover the cat’s eyes. Keep the apostrophes but leave out full stops in the actual meme text; the free-tier image size is fine.

style.prompt:
Turn the supplied cat photograph into a classic image macro meme. Preserve the original photograph, cat's surprised expression and all features. Square composition. Add large bold condensed Impact-style UPPERCASE white lettering with thick black outlines, centered at the top and bottom. Exact top text: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY
Exact bottom text: BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY
Preserve the apostrophes in IT'S exactly. No full stops, quotation marks, or other additional text. Wrap each caption into two lines if needed for large readable lettering. Top caption must stay above the cat's eyes, and bottom caption must stay below the cat's face. Do not cover either eye. Keep the photo otherwise unchanged.
